_comment: Route profiles for the planning panel and EVA mode (Plan/02 sec.5, Plan/09 2-2). Arrays in samples are columns over 2 m samples; stations[].leg summarises the way to the next station.

speed_rule.segment_rule: segment between two samples uses the larger 5 m slope of its two ends

meta.return_rule: same path back; t_ret_s = time from the sample back to the base (equals outbound time because the rule depends only on slope magnitude)
meta.elevation: work/vrt/dem_1m.vrt (HiRISE DEM 1 m), bilinear; climb/descent = sums of 2 m steps
meta.slope: slope_deg: work/stage3/slope_5m.tif (5 m mean DEM, gdaldem). slope_2m_deg: slope_2m.tif. 5 m slope reads ~2.4 deg low where rover tilt >= 10 deg (Plan/10 4); hazards_2m is the reference.
meta.grade: grade_deg: signed along-track slope from neighbouring samples, + = uphill in the outbound direction

A.basis: FINAL (stage 4, Plan/11): route A base = rover waypoint sol 3 (site 2 drive 0), Bradbury Landing, scripts/config.json routes.A.stops[0]

B.basis: FINAL (stage 4, Plan/11): route B base = rover waypoint sol 4614 (site 118 drive 0), scripts/config.json routes.B.stops[0]

line_of_sight.rule: vis 1 = sample cell visible from base; a segment is out of sight if either end is

meta.thermal_inertia: ti: work/vrt/E1_themis_ti_100m.vrt (THEMIS TI 100 m, alignment-corrected), TIU, nearest
meta.night_ir: nir: work/vrt/B4_themis_night_ir_100m.vrt, 8-bit brightness DN (relative, not a temperature)
meta.stations_rule: base / via / dest from config.json routes + starts of 5 m >= 15 deg hazards + turns >= 30 deg (direction over 40 m before vs after), min spacing raised until <= 12 stations, gaps > 250 m split (Plan/09 2-2)
meta.env: routes.<id>.env: rad_period = key of site/data/rad.json periods to use for dose (A: early, B: recent); rems = temperature file. Dose numbers are read from rad.json at run time, not stored here.
meta.rover_tilt: [d_m, tilt_deg, sol] for rover waypoints within 5 m of the route (MSL_waypoints.json)
meta.limits_en: Slope is a 5 m grid mean and can read lower than the real slope on steep ground (median 2.4 deg low where rover tilt >= 10 deg); read the 2 m slope (hazards_2m) as well. Direct line of sight only (no diffraction, no relays). Speed rules and limits are assumptions.

A.name_en: Route A - Bradbury Landing to Yellowknife Bay (flat reference)

env.note_en: RAD periods.early (sols 1-359) and REMS sols 1-360 were measured at this site (rover within ~550 m of Bradbury Landing until sol 358).

base.basis: Plan/02 sec.2 base (assumed): rover waypoint sol 3, site 2 drive 0

B.name_en: Route B - Mount Sharp slope, sol 4614 to sol 4996

env.note_en: RAD periods.recent (sols 4613-4843) and REMS sols 4134-4843 were measured on this route.

base.basis: Plan/02 sec.2 base (assumed): rover waypoint sol 4614, site 118 drive 0
